coordinateRule: native glTF +Y up/+Z forward; Unity importer mirrors X. Joint names Right/Left are already anatomically corrected. Unity local offsets below are AUTHOR metres; TransformPoint includes model scale1.65.
phaseConvention: Normalized phase0 Right initial strike; .5 Left initial strike; increasing phase always forward. Loop endpoint1=0.

contactWeightEnvelope.lockRule: Establish world anchor on contact entry; smooth weight independently. Release on contact exit; reset at stop/dash/collision/large turn. Anchor rolls heel to flat to toe in Walk. Jog/Run use Toe joint pad. Preserve the dense reference marker height during roll, or raycast actual ground; do not force a bbox point below ground.

dash.style: brief tuck/glide at gameplay24m/s; no grounded feet claim

limitations: Authored native straight stance is near-planted, not exact continuous no-slip. Dense exported foot interpolation and turns still need runtime world anchors.
Authoring heel/toe virtual points differ slightly from actual curved surface. Use actualSurfaceLandmarks or dense surface samples for visible ground contact.
Blend duty windows consistently with gait weights; contact0 is right and .5 left in all loops.
